label: The five values
subgoals: Write each line as a pair of fault-free and faulty values
Name the pair 1 and 0 as D and the pair 0 and 1 as D-bar
Mark the fault site D or D-bar when the fault is activated

label: Evaluating gates
subgoals: Split each input into its fault-free and faulty components
Evaluate each machine with three-valued logic
Recombine the two results into one of the five values

label: Multi-gate evaluation
subgoals: Evaluate the gates in topological order
Carry D or D-bar forward through non-controlling side inputs
Collapse partly unknown pairs to X
